svg.title: Local by design
svg.desc: Inside the boundary of your machine: your agent talks to the neuralgraph-memory binary over stdio or HTTP on 127.0.0.1; the binary talks to a local model server (Ollama or LM Studio) and stores everything in one SQLite file. The only outbound call NeuralGraph makes itself is the release version check against GitHub, while the web app is open or when you run update.

svg.text: Everything that touches your conversations runs inside one boundary.
